claim_candidates.subject: India operating fleet
claim_candidates.observed_claim: NPCIL reports 8,780 MWe installed capacity and 24 operating reactors excluding RAPS-1 long shutdown.
claim_candidates.caveat: NPCIL-reported baseline is date-sensitive and does not disclose fleet-wide qualified recurring output.
unknowns: Unit-level yield, maintenance, outage and available net output.
conflicts: BHEL brochure reports a different reactor-count configuration.
claim_candidates.escalation: Reconcile date-stamped NPCIL/PRIS unit status and net output.

claim_candidates.subject: Nuclear Energy Mission
claim_candidates.observed_claim: Government announced a 100 GW nuclear target by 2047 under the SHANTI policy framework.
claim_candidates.caveat: This is a policy target, not committed installed capacity or demonstrated build rate.
unknowns: Finance, licensing, sites, supply chain, workforce and commissioning schedule.
claim_candidates.escalation: Obtain dated programme milestones and a capacity-flow model.

claim_candidates.subject: NPCIL construction portfolio
claim_candidates.observed_claim: NPCIL states seven reactors totaling 6,100 MW are under construction: RAPP-8, KKNPP-3/4 and 5/6, and GHAVP-1/2.
claim_candidates.caveat: Construction capacity is not operating generation or qualified supplier throughput.
unknowns: Actual completion dates, critical path, commissioning and grid synchronization.
conflicts: Older project summaries may show different totals.
claim_candidates.escalation: Verify each project state against dated regulatory and site records.

claim_candidates.subject: NPCIL fleet-mode programme
claim_candidates.observed_claim: Ten additional 700 MWe PHWRs have administrative approval and financial sanction, with preparatory activities at varying stages.
claim_candidates.caveat: Preparatory activities are not construction, operating capacity, or qualified component delivery.
unknowns: Site-specific clearances, long-lead procurement, construction start, supplier allocation and first criticality.
conflicts: Parallel memos incorrectly label this pipeline as under construction.
claim_candidates.escalation: Track each of ten units as separate stateful projects.

claim_candidates.subject: NPCIL 2031-32 outlook
claim_candidates.observed_claim: NPCIL states 21,980 MW capacity is envisaged by 2031–32.
claim_candidates.caveat: An envisaged total is not a committed or operating capacity schedule.
unknowns: Project-level schedule, financing, supply chain and commissioning evidence.
conflicts: A parallel memo reports 22,480 MW; the live overview states 21,980 MW.
claim_candidates.escalation: Resolve the date/configuration basis for competing totals.

claim_candidates.subject: BHEL nuclear portfolio
claim_candidates.observed_claim: BHEL reports 45 nuclear steam generators and 96 reactor headers supplied, and turbine-island EPC execution for seven 700 MWe units.
claim_candidates.caveat: Experience and EPC scope do not establish spare annual capacity, yield, or current qualified delivery rate.
unknowns: Current open capacity, product-level qualification, surveillance and delivery schedule.
conflicts: The brochure fleet baseline differs from current NPCIL counts.
claim_candidates.escalation: Request current facility loading and qualification records.

claim_candidates.subject: LTSSHF
claim_candidates.observed_claim: CRISIL reports a 9,000-tonne-per-year first-phase press capability, second phase on hold, and 100% L&T ownership after NPCIL sold its stake in February 2025.
claim_candidates.caveat: Press capability is not nuclear-component sets/year, qualified output, yield, or free capacity.
unknowns: Current product mix, nuclear qualification, utilization, yield and available slots.
conflicts: Parallel memos repeat a 74:26 L&T:NPCIL JV description contradicted by CRISIL.
claim_candidates.escalation: Confirm facility-level qualified reactor-component throughput.

claim_candidates.subject: Doosan Enerbility
claim_candidates.observed_claim: Doosan reports a 17,000-tonne press, 80,000 tonnes/year with the new press and 140,000 tonnes/year across three presses.
claim_candidates.caveat: The figures cover total forged products and do not isolate nuclear-qualified annual throughput or free capacity.
unknowns: Nuclear product mix, qualification, yield, utilization and available capacity.
claim_candidates.escalation: Obtain product/facility qualification and loading data.

claim_candidates.subject: Integrated Nuclear Recycle Plant
claim_candidates.observed_claim: BARC describes an INRP rationale and a 600 tonnes heavy-metal/year design capacity.
claim_candidates.caveat: Design capacity does not establish construction, commissioning, actual throughput, headroom or future availability.
unknowns: Project state, commissioning, actual tHM throughput, storage and downstream disposal.
conflicts: Parallel notes cite current/planned values not confirmed by the official page.
claim_candidates.escalation: Obtain current facility/project and annual-report evidence.

claim_candidates.subject: BWRX-300 Darlington
claim_candidates.observed_claim: GE Vernova Hitachi reports construction beginning in May 2025, completion estimated late 2029, commercial operation by end-2030 and a 300 MWe design.
claim_candidates.caveat: Vendor project claims are not operating experience or proven serial factory output.
unknowns: Regulatory milestones, construction progress, first nuclear concrete, commissioning and qualified supply chain.
claim_candidates.escalation: Revalidate project state and vendor versus regulator evidence.

claim_candidates.subject: AERB licensing
claim_candidates.observed_claim: AERB describes staged consent across siting, construction, commissioning, operation and decommissioning.
claim_candidates.caveat: A licensing framework does not prove that a facility, supplier, process or product passed each gate.
unknowns: Facility-specific approvals, inspection findings, QA records and operating licence status.
claim_candidates.escalation: Map each project and supplier to explicit regulatory gates.

claim_candidates.subject: Nuclear Fuel Complex
claim_candidates.observed_claim: NFC describes an integrated uranium and zirconium cycle through sponge, alloy, Zircaloy, fuel and special-material processes, with independent QA and a Kota facility being established.
claim_candidates.caveat: Role/process-chain existence does not provide current annual fuel, zirconium, yield or qualified output capacity.
unknowns: Numeric capacity, product qualification, utilization and available supply.
conflicts: Parallel notes cite unverified 250→600/1000 t/y figures.
claim_candidates.escalation: Request facility-level production and qualification data.

claim_candidates.subject: Walchandnagar Industries
claim_candidates.observed_claim: WIL reports Class I prequalification and eight 700 MWe moderator heat exchangers fabricated and supplied, alongside nuclear code and welding qualification practices.
claim_candidates.caveat: Historical/project supply and qualification claims do not establish fleet-scale annual throughput or available capacity.
unknowns: Current rate, product/customer qualification scope, surveillance and open capacity.
claim_candidates.escalation: Verify current certified capacity and delivery queue.

claim_candidates.subject: PFBR
claim_candidates.observed_claim: DAE reports PFBR milestones including sodium filling, pump commissioning and core loading begun in March 2024.
claim_candidates.caveat: A historical milestone does not establish current criticality, commercial operation, qualified fuel cycle or recurring output.
unknowns: Current criticality, commissioning, operating licence, power ascension and fuel-cycle readiness.
conflicts: Parallel future PFBR claims and a mismatched PIB URL require correction.
claim_candidates.escalation: Revalidate current PFBR status from a direct official source.

claim_candidates.subject: Doosan Enerbility
claim_candidates.observed_claim: Knowledge-graph row 16 records a reported ForgeFacility in Changwon and a 17,000-tonne press/output note; the raw row has a comma-overflow repair.
claim_candidates.caveat: Raw CSV overflow was joined into the final field for staging review; semantic interpretation remains reviewable.
unknowns: Exact numeric field interpretation and nuclear-qualified throughput.
conflicts: Overflow split 17,000 into separate CSV fields.
claim_candidates.escalation: Review repaired row against the raw bytes before any promotion.

claim_candidates.subject: AERB future review bandwidth
claim_candidates.observed_claim: The knowledge graph marks future AERB review bandwidth as unresolved.
claim_candidates.caveat: No staffing, queue, review-time or parallel-project capacity evidence is established in this slice.
unknowns: Staffing, queue, review duration, inspection load and project portfolio.
claim_candidates.escalation: Obtain dated regulator staffing and workload evidence.

claim_candidates.subject: NPCIL fleet baseline
claim_candidates.observed_claim: Structured sources contain 8.18 GWe and 8.78 GWe baseline values; current NPCIL overview reports 8,780 MW.
claim_candidates.caveat: The discrepancy may be date/configuration related; do not average or silently select a value.
unknowns: Date/configuration basis and unit inclusion/exclusion.
conflicts: NPCIL/BHEL and KG baseline values conflict.
claim_candidates.escalation: Resolve against dated primary unit list and preserve source version.

claim_candidates.subject: LTSSHF ownership
claim_candidates.observed_claim: Older memo text says 74:26 L&T:NPCIL JV while CRISIL reports NPCIL sold its 26% stake on 18 Feb 2025 and LTSSHF became 100% L&T-owned.
claim_candidates.caveat: Ownership must be versioned; it does not determine qualified output capacity.
unknowns: Corporate registry and current facility ownership confirmation.
conflicts: KG/memos preserve the older JV wording.
claim_candidates.escalation: Use the dated CRISIL claim as a staging correction; seek corporate record before promotion.

claim_candidates.subject: India nuclear qualified throughput
claim_candidates.observed_claim: This corpus does not establish site/product-specific qualified recurring throughput or available capacity for the Indian nuclear equipment, fuel-cycle and back-end system.
claim_candidates.caveat: Facility presence, role, design capacity, order book, experience and operating income are insufficient to infer qualified available throughput.
unknowns: Exact facility, product scope, qualification, yield, utilization, maintenance, customer acceptance and open capacity.
claim_candidates.escalation: Escalate before any capacity promotion or feasibility calculation.

claim_candidates.subject: PFBR source URL
claim_candidates.observed_claim: The supplied PIB PRID=1992451 link is identified as a university-convocation release rather than PFBR status evidence.
claim_candidates.caveat: Do not use the mismatched URL for PFBR commissioning or criticality claims.
unknowns: Correct official PFBR release and current commissioning evidence.
conflicts: Parallel notes attribute PFBR status to the wrong PIB release.
claim_candidates.escalation: Replace with a verified direct source before promotion.
